purpose: Superseded top60 pilot for input/execution validation only. The user research universe is docs/factor-experiments-wide-config.json.
universe: TWSE ordinary stocks, top 60 by 2020-01-02 turnover; retain all frozen codes
entry: Next session open after signal close
exit: 20th holding session close; stay cash until next entry open
baseline: At signal date require 61 complete sessions, price >8 and 20-day average turnover >=NTD50m; rank by adjusted 20-session return, equal-weight top10

strategies.rule: Signal volume >1.5x prior20-session mean volume, and signal close >=previous close
20-session log-return volatility <= median among eligible frozen-universe stocks
>50% of observed frozen60 stocks above MA20; require >=30 observations; otherwise cash
Top10 inverse 20-session volatility weights, cap20% per name, unallocatable capital cash
Only signal dates in final15+ calendar days of Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec; other cohorts cash
Only stocks with observed cash-only ex-dividend event on signal day or within previous5 sessions
Exclude stocks with observed cash-only ex-dividend event on signal day or within previous5 sessions

priceAdjustment: Forward cumulative before_price/after_price action factor applied only on event date and later; reference-price dividend reinvestment proxy, not audited cash-flow total return
benchmark: Official TAIEX total-return index; entry open derived from same-date TR/price index scale
knownLimits: Fixed liquid TWSE subset, not all Taiwan equities
No optimizing thresholds or selecting winners on the validation period
Events use only effective events already observed, not hindsight future event calendar
Historical date-only events do not establish earlier announcement timestamps
Unresolved missing execution data suppresses deployable portfolio metrics
